InstanceVersionUpgrade.kernelVersion:
Version number for major version upgrade. Empty for non-major version upgrades.
1. The target version must be higher than the current version;
2. Standard edition series 3 can be upgraded to series 6 or 7;
3. Series 4 can be upgraded to series 6 or 7;
4. Series 5 can be upgraded to series 6 or 7;
5. Series 6 can be upgraded to series 7;
InstanceVersionUpgrade.isDefer: Execution time. `false`: execute immediately; `true`: execute during maintenance window
